thread:
support: FYI — customer 'FinPay' opened a severity-2 ticket: large p99 latency spikes and occasional timeouts for EU->APAC requests starting ~09:10 UTC. Observed in their traces and our frontdoor logs. p95 up from ~120ms -> ~900ms, p99 around 2.4s. They're hitting /v1/generate mostly.

alice: Ack. Which POPs are in the path? any cross-region hairpin visible? :point_up:

support: Initial pointers: most affected from eu-west1 -> apac-sg1. We see increased TLS handshake retries and additional cross-AZ hops in traceroutes. Attaching short snippet from frontdoor logs:

```
[2026-05-04T09:12:03Z] req_id=abc123 client=203.0.113.45 route=eu-west1->apac-sg1 tls_handshake_ms=1200 total_ms=2400
[2026-05-04T09:12:04Z] req_id=abc124 client=198.51.100.12 route=eu-west1->apac-sg1 tls_handshake_ms=1300 total_ms=2500
```

ben: Noted. I just kicked off edge-prober to run repeated path probes eu-west1 -> apac-sg1 and a control eu-west1 -> apac-tok. Will paste results in a sec.

devops-bot: edge-prober results finished (100 probes): eu-west1->apac-sg1 median RTT=320ms p95=950ms, traceroute shows an extra hop via provider-a XCH-3 (AS64501) compared to control path.

carla: Sounds like a routing shift at upstream provider. Any DNS TTL flips or GSLB changes around 09:00? I don't see scheduled changes on our side.

alice: I see a config push to GSLB on 2026-05-04T08:58Z from infra-team (no rollout notes). @infra-bot can you confirm what was in that push?

infra-bot: Deploy 2026-05-04T08:58:12 by infra-ops: updated fallback priority for apac pools to prefer apac-sg1 over apac-tok for legacy customers. Rollout target: 100%. Change-id: gslb-4591.

ben: That aligns with timing. If GSLB re-prioritized apac-sg1 and upstream routing to apac-sg1 currently takes a weird AS path, that could cause hairpin. Suggest temporarily pinning FinPay's traffic to apac-tok via route override while we work with provider.

support: FinPay is fine with a temporary mitigation. Please make sure no service restart required.

alice: I'll create an override rule scoped to FinPay's org (route-policy = prefer apac-tok) and set a 2h TTL. Applying now.

devops-bot: route-override applied: org=FinPay rule=prefer-apac-tok ttl=2h

alice: Mitigation applied. Can FinPay confirm if their end-to-end p99 improves? Support, let them know.

support: Updated the customer — they report immediate improvement in 2 of 3 repro cases. p99 reported down to ~220ms in quick checks. Thanks.

carla: Meanwhile, I'll open a ticket with provider-a to escalate the asymmetric path via XCH-3 and request path normalization. Include traceroutes and timestamps.

ben: Also collecting tcpdump from the edge node handling eu-west1 egress to apac-sg1 for 09:05-09:20 window. Will upload pcap to the incident folder.

infra-bot: pcap uploaded: s3://redwood-incidents/2961123581/edge-egress-eu-west1-09-05.pcap

alice: Action items:
  - carla: escalate to provider-a with traceroutes + logs (owner)
  - ben: upload pcap + tcpdump + edge-prober output to incident folder (owner)
  - alice: monitor for rollback side effects and keep route override TTL timer (owner)
  - support: keep customer updated & collect repro traces if they see regressions (owner)

carla: I'm pinging provider-a support and their NOC now. ETA for first response ~30m.

support: Customer updated that they received a follow-up from their network team and will also run mtr to capture from their side.

alice: Temporary mitigations done. If provider responds with a fix we can revert override earlier. Leaving channel open for updates. Will escalate to oncall if we see reappearance.

ben: If anyone needs quick reproduction, run:

```
# repro traffic from eu-west1 to our edge
curl -i -X POST https://eu-west1.edge.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 10
```

support: Noted. Closing the customer escalation as 'mitigated' pending provider remediation. Will re-open if they see more failures.

alice: Filing an RCA stub and scheduling follow-up: 2026-05-05 13:00 UTC. Please add any logs/pcaps to the incident folder before then.

carla: provider-a responded: "we see transit flapping on XCH-3, working on route dampening. ETA 3-6h." I'll paste their ticket # when they share.

support: FinPay says things look stable for now. Marking customer ticket as 'monitoring' rather than 'open'.

devops-bot: reminder: route-override TTL expires in 1h 58m

alice: I'll extend TTL if provider ETA slips. Good work team. :thumbsup:
